data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a substantial gross strengthening of reserves in 2024: gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were $328.762m and the reported increase in prior year provisions during 2024 was $234.224m (gross), representing a material adverse development (strengthening) of c.71% of opening reserves. The note attributes significant adverse development across prior years, with underwriting commentary highlighting mid-sized losses in Energy, Power and Aviation and ongoing geopolitical uncertainty (notably the Russia/Ukraine conflict and events in the Middle East) as contributing factors. The Russia/Ukraine conflict is specifically quantified in the report with $38.7m of net booked reserves. No single named natural catastrophe is identified as the primary driver; development appears to be a combination of large loss development and adverse reserve movements on earlier underwriting years.

In 2022, the market was impacted by the Russia/Ukraine conflict which continues. ... Booked reserves of $38.7m net of reinsurance and reinstatement premiums has been made.

The uncertain and complicated global geopolitical landscape that was exacerbated in 2023 by the Hamas attacks on Israel, the subsequent invasion of Gaza and the consequential ongoing effects that is having within the wilder Middle East region, continued in 2024.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts in the report are presented in USD and the primary tables show values in $'000 (thousands). Values above have been converted to millions (divide $'000 by 1,000). The prior year development figure used is the GROSS 'Change in prior year provisions' row from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (explicit gross figure). Causes and LOB-level movements are inferred from narrative (moderate confidence) as the report does not allocate the gross PYD by LOB in the technical provisions note. exact_reserve_text is taken from the tabular row in Note 19. Some causal attribution (e.g. to Energy/Aviation) is based on underwriting commentary rather than an explicit per-LOB PYD table.
